about: Say hello. The model fails with a server error, the harness retries once and the turn fails.

known.line: note: Warning — Falling back from WebSockets to HTTPS transport. We’re currently experiencing high demand, which may cause temporary errors.
known.reason: Codex 0.159.3 keeps no warning in its rollout: should_persist_event_msg (codex-rs/rollout/src/policy.rs) lists Warning among its transient events. Codex warns when it gives up on the scripted model's failing WebSocket for HTTPS, so whether a recording has the warning depends on its retry timing.

Mako sums up the retries it watched on the wire (Codex's `error` notifications with willRetry) in one marker; Codex keeps none of those notifications in its rollout, so only the live drawing has the measure (RETRY_MARKERS, declared stream-only).
